title: Selection Integrity for LLM Graph Memory: An Accumulability Criterion for Information-Flow-Blind Retrieval
title_zh: LLM 图记忆的选择完整性：面向信息流盲检索的可累积性准则
abstract_en: Agent memory is moving to graphs, and the provenance defenses now being built for it all check one thing: the provenance of the records an agent retrieves. We show that this entire class of defense is blind by construction. A long-term graph memory runs a global selection step over writable graph structure, so structure that an untrusted principal writes changes \emph{which} authenticated facts are selected while the cited evidence stays fully authenticated; faithful information-flow control (IFC), checking the provenance of what the reader uses (all of it authenticated), makes the byte-identical decision to no defense at all, across document-QA substrates and real multi-session agent memory. In the most consequential instance, a no-source structural write silently misdirects $28$ irreversible ledger transfers over $499$ live actions: faithful IFC permits every one, and \authselect\ prevents every one. We then characterize exactly which memories are exposed: a selector admits the channel when its structural term can reallocate an $Ω(1)$ share of top-$k$ membership past a selected fact's margin. Personalized PageRank can, since a sourceless write reroutes conserved random-walk mass; a content-fixed reranker cannot, and Graphiti's node-distance, which leans on structure \emph{more} than PageRank does, stays immune. Reallocatability, not reliance, is the predictor. We prove the immune case in general and the open case under a chokepoint condition we verify. Closing the channel forces any provenance defense to recompute selection on the authenticated subgraph, which is what \authselect\ does, at zero over-block and $2$--$3\%$ latency.
abstract_zh: 本文研究 LLM Agent 长期图记忆中的 provenance defense（来源防御）缺陷。作者指出，现有防御通常只检查 Agent 实际检索到的记录来源，却忽略了全局 selection（选择）过程本身会受可写图结构影响：不可信主体写入的结构边或节点关系，可以改变哪些已认证事实进入 top-k 检索结果，而被引用证据仍然完全可信。因此，忠实的 IFC（Information-Flow Control，信息流控制）在文档问答和真实多会话 Agent 记忆中会做出与无防御完全相同的决策。实验中，一个无来源结构写入在 499 次真实动作中静默误导 28 次不可逆账本转账，IFC 全部放行，而作者提出的 AuthSelect 全部阻止。论文进一步刻画了哪些图记忆选择器会暴露该通道：当结构项能在已选事实的 margin 之外重新分配 Ω(1) 比例的 top-k 成员资格时，攻击成立。Personalized PageRank 因随机游走质量可被无源写入重路由而易受影响；content-fixed reranker 不易受影响；Graphiti 的 node-distance 虽更依赖结构，却保持免疫。关键预测因素不是“依赖结构程度”，而是 reallocatability（可重分配性）。作者证明了免疫情形，并在可验证 chokepoint 条件下分析开放情形。最终，关闭该通道要求 provenance defense 在认证子图上重新执行 selection，AuthSelect 正是这样做，且无过度阻断，延迟仅增加 2–3%。
key_points_zh: 指出现有 LLM graph memory 的 provenance defense 只验证被检索记录来源，天然忽略 selection 阶段受到不可信图结构操控的风险。
证明 faithful IFC 在该场景下信息流盲：即使所有被引用事实都已认证，不可信结构写入仍可改变 top-k 检索结果，从而造成与无防御相同的错误决策。
提出 reallocatability（可重分配性）作为判定选择器是否易受攻击的核心准则，而不是简单看方法是否依赖图结构。
实验显示 Personalized PageRank 易受无来源结构写入影响；content-fixed reranker 与 Graphiti node-distance 在文中条件下保持免疫。
提出 AuthSelect：在 authenticated subgraph 上重新计算 selection，可阻断攻击且无 over-block，额外延迟约 2–3%。

llm_assessment.comment: A rigorous security contribution that exposes a subtle graph-memory provenance failure and proposes a practical authenticated-selection defense.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一项严谨的安全研究，揭示了图记忆溯源防护的隐蔽失效模式，并提出了实用的认证选择防御。
